set firewall family inet filter ac.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term default.explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

then accept.explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

passive.explanation: Configures the ISIS protocol ' s lo0 interface to passive mode.

term else.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing policy by defining a term within a policy statement, where `[parameter1]` is the policy name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

reject.explanation: Configure the action of the policy statement as accepted.
